guide: trades are returned most-recent-first. Each entry is a closed/realizing trade with the realized gain/loss on it. price is the execution (close) price. The window is a preset span (not the last week). Paginate with cursor: pass next_cursor from the previous response; an empty next_cursor means there are no more trades. An empty trades list means there were no realized trades in the window — a valid result, not an error. To filter more than one symbol, call once per symbol. Treat figures as informational, not a tax/performance advice.
